title: feat(lint): six publish-time checks for metadata the runtime ignores, and four build probes over what landed
body:
Fixes #34776
Fixes #35146

Clause-②: no (narrowing: six publish-time refusals of metadata the schema accepts today)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #35245

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:发布时新增六条检查(五条拒绝、一条警告),拦住"能通过 schema、运行时却不起作用"的元数据;发布回执新增四条数据探针警告(仪表盘卡片全是 0、汇总字段从未计算、示例数据引用不存在的记录、流程连接器动作不存在)。
- 为什么改:这些问题过去只在用户打开页面、保存记录或流程运行时才暴露;现在在发布那一刻就告诉作者,并给出修法。
- 风险与回滚:已存的元数据不会被改写,也不会在启动时被拒;下一次发布带这五类错误的元数据会被拒并给出修法。两个示例已补上 `initialStates` 与 `timeoutMs`,ADR-0087 账本已登记 `publish-refuses-metadata-the-runtime-ignores`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`(三条新规则的登记与运行面)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`(四个探针平面,尤其汇总与引用两段读数据的逻辑)、`examples/app-crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts`(商机允许以任一阶段创建的理由)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-inert-object-declarations.test.ts`,预期 5 例全绿;再在 `examples/app-crm` 跑 `pnpm exec objectstack build`,预期作者规则一条发现都没有、构建成功。
- 需要你做的:无需决策。showcase 三个只在 update 时运行的状态机上新加的 `initialStates` 只是声明、创建时不生效;席位选择本 PR 保持规则原样,规则不判这类状态机的收窄已另立卡 #35251。等审核通过后由席位落地。

## What changes

**#34776: six authoring rules**, in the registry both the runtime publish gate and `objectstack validate` / `lint` / `compile` / `build` run. Each finding names its fix; `os explain RULE` carries the reasoning.

| Rule | Tier | Runtime types | What it refuses |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flow-node-type-no-executor` | error | flow | a node whose `type` no executor in this deployment runs (every run fails with `NO_EXECUTOR`) |
| `flow-approval-decision-unrouted` | error | flow (inside `lintFlowPatterns`) | an `approval` node whose decision out-edges are not exactly `approve` and `reject` |
| `flow-http-timeout-missing` | warning | flow (inside `lintFlowPatterns`) | an `http` node with no `timeoutMs` |
| `field-boolean-required` | error | object | a `boolean` / `toggle` field marked `required` |
| `state-machine-no-initial-states` | error | object | a `state_machine` validation with no `initialStates` |
| `action-no-object-binding` | error | action | a standalone action with `locations` and no `objectName` |

- Rule (1) is judged only against the **sealed** node-type vocabulary. New `AutomationEngine.getSealedNodeTypeVocabulary()` answers `undefined` until `sealNodeTypeVocabulary()` ran at `kernel:bootstrapped`, so a boot-time read never judges a vocabulary that is still filling (AGENTS.md "Startup registry reads"). The publish gate reads it per flow write through `sealedFlowNodeTypeVocabulary` (protocol-authoring-gate.ts). The CLI has no vocabulary (the stack does not say which plugins the deployment loads), so the rule judges nothing on the CLI.
- Rule (5) is a warning: measured in `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`, the node arms a timer only when `timeoutMs` is set and egress applies no default, so the call can wait as long as the connection stays open. That is a risk, not a certain failure.
- Rule (6): `validateActionLocations` (`action-no-placement`) is an advisory, CLI-only placement rule and the runtime gate does not run it (measured in the registry: `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`). The binding question is a separate gating rule that does run on runtime `action` writes.
- `protocol.ts` was at its facade line ceiling (11705 of 11705 on main). The gate's host for `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` is now the draft-verdict host (`draftVerdictHost()`, a superset of the members it reads), which removed a duplicated host literal and keeps the file at 11704 lines.

**#35146: four build probes** (warnings on the publish receipt, each with `userMessage` in all eleven platform locales):

| Code | Artefact | What the person will see |
|---|---|---|
| `widget_empty_result` | dashboard (ref: dataset, member: widget) | the card's real query answers only zero/null measures: an empty "0" tile |
| `rollup_never_computed` | object (ref member: summary field) | a roll-up blank on every parent that has children |
| `seed_reference_unresolved` | seed (ref: object, member: field) | sample records whose reference names no row: the edit form cannot save them |
| `flow_connector_action_unresolved` | flow (ref: connector, member: action) | a `connector_action` step the runtime cannot dispatch: refused name, no handler, or degraded |

- `widget_empty_result` adds only what `empty_query` misses: no rows over an object with rows stays `empty_query`, and an empty answer to a caller who sees no rows stays silent, as pinned by #25484.
- The roll-up probe judges only parents a sampled child points at (via `relationshipField`, else the one `master_detail`/`lookup` back to the parent), only a field UNSET on all of them (a computed zero is a value), and skips a roll-up with its own `filter`.
- The connector probe asks the engine the same lookups, in the same order, as the `connector_action` executor (`resolveConnectorInstanceFor` for the publishing package, `resolveConnectorAction`, `getConnectorDegradedReason`); publish passes the automation service and `request.packageId`.
- Spec: `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema` descriptions only (code list, warning meaning, `flow` artefact, `connector` ref, `member` meaning); the protocol reference is regenerated.

**Cloud sources ported** (read at cloud `origin/main` c21b3723c41a66a9a3c0c27e0f80b87dec8f86f9, with `git show`, nothing checked out):

- `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/data-reality.ts`: semantics and fix text of `rollup_never_computed`, `widget_empty_result` and the reference-integrity check (`seed_reference_unresolvable` there; here a warning named `seed_reference_unresolved` as #35146 asks).
- `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/flow-reality.ts`: `flow_connector_action_unresolved`.
- `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/graph-lint.ts`: read for the approval-edge, boolean-required and state-machine semantics.
- `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/view-query-probe.ts`: read, nothing ported (view column-summary query probes are outside both cards).
- `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/flow-credential-door.ts`: read, nothing ported. It is credential policy over the hosted vault, which is hosted-only state.

## Tests

- New pins: `validate-flow-node-executors.test.ts`, `validate-inert-object-declarations.test.ts`, `validate-action-object-binding.test.ts`, two describes in `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts`, `build-probes-landed-data.test.ts`, seven new cases in `build-probes-user-message.test.ts`, two in `flow-node-type-audit.test.ts`. Each rule and probe has a positive pin and a must-stay-silent pin, plus the runtime gate path (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`) for the lint rules.
- Updated fixtures: two `http` nodes in `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts` gained `timeoutMs`; the object-write roster pin in `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` lists `validateInertObjectDeclarations`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Examples (seat answer A, claim amendment 6987471285).** The five state machines now declare `initialStates`, and the four showcase `http` nodes declare `timeoutMs: 10000`. `objectstack build` of app-crm and app-showcase raises no finding, and the rule is unchanged.
  - `crm_lead`: `['new']`, the field's default and the machine's only root.
  - `crm_opportunity`: all five stages. The app records deals already won or lost: `OpportunityStageHook` sets the probability on INSERT for exactly that case, and `test/opportunity-stage-hook.test.ts` creates `closed_won`, `closed_lost` and `proposal` deals. A narrower list would refuse those creates.
  - `showcase_account` `['prospect']`, `showcase_project` health `['green']`, `showcase_task` `['backlog', 'todo']`: each is the field's default (plus `todo` for a task). These three machines declare `events: ['update']`, so the server never runs them on create, and the list states the entry without enforcing it. Seat answer B: the rule ships as written here, and skipping update-only machines is follow-up #35251.
- **ADR-0087 (seat answer A).** One notice-only entry, `publish-refuses-metadata-the-runtime-ignores` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`). The changeset carries `adr-0087: registered`; `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` are green.
- **Draft door (#34766): accepted deviation.** `draftPublishJudgement` runs the authoring gate, so it carries the six rules' findings. It carries no build-probe findings, because the probes read what a publish landed and a draft lands none. The seat records this as an accepted deviation of #35146's Done-when (claim amendment 6987471285).
- **Skills text that teaches each trap** (not edited here): node types: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (the plugin node-type table, "no executor for the node type"); approval edges: `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` (the `approve` / `reject` out-edges); http timeout: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (the `http` row, "always set `timeoutMs`"); `initialStates`: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md`; action binding: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` ("A record button needs a placement"). Boolean required: no skill text found that teaches it.
- The open seed loader already reports references it could not resolve on `seedApplied`. `seed_reference_unresolved` is the check on what actually landed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs at e45bb89240</summary>

- `@objectstack/dogfood` (full battery, narrowing arm), closure built with the examples included: lock VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 481 passed, 3 skipped (484) · Tests 4082 passed, 68 skipped (4150).
- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0. The app-crm and app-showcase builds report no author-time finding.
- `@objectstack/example-crm` test: 7 files, 51/51 passed (`opportunity-stage-hook.test.ts` included). `@objectstack/example-showcase` verify (validate + typecheck + test): 48 files, 549/549 passed.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `gen:migration-registry`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, migrations and upgrade-guide tests 228/228, typecheck: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Earlier, unchanged since: `@objectstack/lint` typecheck + full suite 9271/9271; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck + build + full suite 23184 passed, 45 skipped (at cd15670b2c, before the main merge and the example/ledger commit, which do not touch either package).
- Ablations, one per rule and probe (at cd15670b2c), via `ablation-replace.mjs` with an anchor that must hit; `git diff HEAD` was empty after each restore. All ten went red: node-executor 3, approval-edges 2, http-timeout 1, boolean-required 2, state-machine 2, action-binding 2, widget-zeros 1, rollup 1, seed-ref 1, connector 1. The first attempt at five of them was a no-op (the replacement `continue;` already occurred in the file, and the tool refused). Those five were re-run with marked replacements.

</details>

- `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (cli): 3/3.
